subject: Mutual Action Plan and Security Timeline for LucentPay evaluation
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.h@lucentpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan and initial security/timing questions

Claire — thanks for the time yesterday. As discussed, I’m attaching a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that aligns our evaluation milestones with LucentPay’s security gates (SOC 2 review, SIG/CAIQ questionnaire, DPA review, and data retention confirmation).

High-level asks in the MAP: 
- SOC 2: we’ll provide our latest SOC 2 report and control summary; LucentPay to confirm which control families require POA&Ms or additional evidence.
- SIG/CAIQ: please send the completed SIG/CAIQ (we can also pre-fill sections on our side).
- DPA: we’ve attached a DPA draft and highlighted common redlines; legal should aim for a 5-business-day turnaround per redline set.
- Data retention/residency: specify retention windows per data class (PII, transaction traces, logs).

Next steps: 
1) Review attached MAP and SIG spreadsheet — Arjun/Claire, confirm acceptance of milestones by EOD Friday (10/09).
2) Ben will run a short staging demo to show access controls and logging (10/12).
3) Legal + Kimberly to coordinate DPA redlines (target resolution by 10/15).

Attachments: LucentPay-MAP-20261007.pdf (MAP), LucentPay-SIG-CAIQ-filled.xlsx (blank copy for you to fill)

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Sale Engineer | Redwood Inference
(priyom.das@redwood.com)

---

From: Claire Huang <claire.h@lucentpay.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun@lucentpay.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan and initial security/timing questions

Thanks Priyom — received and reviewed briefly. A few clarifications from our side: 
1) SOC 2: LucentPay will need the SOC 2 Type II report covering the last 12 months and a brief narrative on customer data segregation. If there are any open exceptions, note them.
2) SIG/CAIQ: we prefer to complete the SIG ourselves but would appreciate pre-filled answers for the architectural and ops sections. We’ll return the completed file by 10/11.
3) DPA: our legal team requires that any subprocessor list be attached and that deletion/return language includes a 60-day window for confirmed deletions.
4) Data retention: for transaction traces we must have a maximum 7-day retention in non-prod, 365-day retention in prod; logs can be aggregated/anonymized after 90 days.

We can commit to milestone acceptance by 10/09 as long as Redwood confirms the SOC 2 doc and provides a standard subprocessor appendix.

I’ll loop in procurement if we hit redlines on the DPA.

— Claire
Claire Huang
Head of Platform Security | LucentPay
claire.h@lucentpay.com

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.h@lucentpay.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan and initial security/timing questions — technical notes

Claire — quick technical notes to align expectations before the demo: 
- SOC 2 evidence: we’ll attach the system architecture diagrams, encryption-at-rest/in-transit config, and sample control evidence (IAM policy exports, audit logs index). If LucentPay needs raw log exports for sampling, we can provide anonymized extracts under NDA.
- Access controls: staging demo on 10/12 will show RBAC, audit trail for API keys, and our KV cache expiry behavior (relevant for data leakage concerns).
- Data residency: Redwood hosted deployments can pin region to us-west-2, and we support private deployments if LucentPay requires on-prem or VPC.

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.h@lucentpay.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood DPA draft and proposed redlines

Claire / Priyom — attaching our DPA draft (Redwood-DPA-draft-20261010.pdf). Key notes on our proposed language: 
- Subprocessors: we provide a maintained appendix; we are willing to provide a bulk export of the subprocessor list and discuss EU-residency options for any specified data classes.
- Deletion window: we typically commit to a 30-day deletion confirmation; LucentPay’s ask of 60 days is reasonable but needs legal signoff because of backup/replication windows — suggested compromise: 45-day confirmed deletion, with an operational runbook for faster retrieval if required.
- Audit & access: SOC 2 report and third-party attestations will be provided; on-site audits are available for Dedicated/Private customers under terms.

If LucentPay can accept 45 days for deletion confirmation, that materially shortens negotiation time. Please confirm.

Attachments: Redwood-DPA-draft-20261010.pdf

— Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

---

From: Claire Huang <claire.h@lucentpay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA draft and proposed redlines — acceptance and next steps

Thanks all — LucentPay legal reviewed the DPA draft. We appreciate the flexibility on subprocessors and the on-site audit option. On deletion window: LucentPay will accept the 45-day confirmed deletion plus the operational runbook guarantee for emergency purge within 7 days for scoped datasets (we’ll include the scoped datasets in our SIG/CAIQ answers).

We’re good to accept the MAP milestones assuming: 
- Redwood provides the SOC 2 Type II report and the subprocessor appendix by end of day 10/13.
- Ben’s demo on 10/12 covers RBAC and log sampling as noted.
- Final DPA with redline resolution by 10/15 so procurement can sign by 10/18.

I’ve attached the completed SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet with notes (LucentPay-SIG-CAIQ-filled.xlsx). If you can confirm the SOC 2 package timing we’ll mark milestone A (security intake) as green and proceed to the staging demo.

— Claire
Claire Huang
Head of Platform Security | LucentPay
claire.h@lucentpay.com
